Our busiest moments - major sporting events, new market launches, and B2B partner go-lives - are when the platform matters most, and the Platform team makes sure the foundations hold. You’ll take part in the on-call rotation, automate away operational toil, apply secure-by-default practices to everything you build, and support product development squads with the environments, pipelines, and tooling they need to move quickly and safely. You’ll work with limited oversight on 2–3 month pieces of work and contribute to larger initiatives led by Senior engineers. Pillar 2: Reliability & Operations Keeping the platform healthy and the team ready for peak events: Observability: Build and maintain metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting (Google Cloud Operations Suite, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry or equivalents) for the components you own; define and track SLIs/SLOs. On-call duties and escalations are additionally compensated via callout pay. Runbooks & Post-Incident Reviews: Write and maintain accurate runbooks; contribute to blameless post-incident reviews and see durable follow-up actions through to completion. Guardrails in Delivery: Contribute to policy-as-code across Terraform and security scanning (SCA/SAST, container image scanning) in GitLab pipelines, working alongside our Security function. Security Reviews: Consider security during design, raise implications explicitly, and contribute to security reviews of your own and others’ components. Working with others Product Development Squads: Understand their needs, unblock delivery, and communicate progress, risks, and operational status clearly. Platform Team: Deliver alongside Senior engineers; contribute to shared modules, patterns, and standards; write clear documentation for what you own. Coaching: Pair with and review the work of Junior engineers, explaining your decisions so they can learn from them. CI/CD: Proficient at building and debugging pipelines (GitLab CI or similar), including artifact handling and deployment strategies. Observability: Proficient with metrics, logs, and traces; has built dashboards and actionable alerting and understands SLIs/SLOs. Linux & Networking: Proficient with Linux systems (processes, filesystems, systemd, shell) and a working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, and VPC networking. Scripting & Automation: Proficient in at least one of Python, Go, or Bash, and able to read the others. Operations: Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation and handling common incidents calmly and methodically. Security Fundamentals: Working knowledge of secure-by-default practices in cloud infrastructure: least privilege, secrets management, safe configuration. Highly Desirable Experience with high-traffic or real-time systems (sports, betting, finance, media streaming). Hands-on use of AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) with an understanding of context management, sub-agents, MCP, and hooks. Experience with GitOps-style workflows (e.g. Argo CD or Flux) for managing Kubernetes and infrastructure changes. Exposure to policy-as-code (OPA/Conftest, Sentinel, or similar) and security scanning in pipelines. Exposure to security or compliance practices in regulated environments (e.g. gambling regulation, SOC 2, ISO 27001). Cost and efficiency awareness in cloud environments (rightsizing, committed use, FinOps practices). Calm under Pressure: You stay methodical during incidents, ask for help early, and follow through on the actions that stop it happening again.
